selection_uses: data geometry, uncertainties, point count, observed slope only; no residuals
vectors: recovered original binary MLE; SHA256 in INPUT_AUTHORITY.json
synthetic_model: baryon only, n=8, D0=10, sigmaD=1, sigmai=3deg, U=1, sigma_sys=3, r=linspace(1,8),vd=80*r**beta,y=vd+3,e=2
analytic_reference: nonhalo dvm/dD=vm/(2D); NFW analytic halo radial derivative plus baryon amplitude; Ji=-y cot for transformed residual; -vm cot for fixed frame

materiality_flags.interpretation: diagnostic flags, not universal scientific validity thresholds; no post-refit prediction

parameter_points: selected U +0.01 if within bounds else -0.01
callback_design: static source call trace plus execute source AST nested optimizer callbacks with prescribed inputs only; no optimizer driver or optimize routine is called
quadrature_bounds: independent normalized Gaussian weights on zD,zi within +/-3, truncated D>0 and 0<i<90deg; no cos(i) prior; Gauss-Legendre products
conditional: fixed nominal y0; mu=vm(D)*sin(i)/sin(i0); diag e0^2+sigma_sys^2 (B0), diag e0^2+(sigma_sys*sin(i)/sin(i0))^2 (B1); no propagated terms
linear_references: A_Donly replaces JD with full distance derivative, retains model inclination
A_full_transformed uses full residual y-based Ji
A_fixed_frame uses full distance and model-based Ji
budget: 6 real galaxies *7 models;3 synthetic baryon controls;3 nuisance galaxies *7 models*2 floor conventions*4 orders <= 1e6 node-model evaluations; time limit 15min; no extra adaptive cases
stop_rules: if convention unsupported mark affected test BLOCKED_BY_CONVENTION; run only explicit conditional source-backed catalog transform
no refit or production changes even after failure
